messages:
incident-bot: P0: deploy pipeline failed health checks for release/edge-2026-03-15; symptoms=high db lock/writes failing — paging oncall @pager

Aisha Patel: paging — getting alerts about 502s and transaction timeouts. Error spike started ~5m ago.

Nina Chen: customer reports for a few customers seeing write errors and timeouts when saving prompts. Support triage: 12 tickets from high-usage tenants.

Aisha Patel: looking at DB dashboard — large number of 'waiting for table metadata lock' + long-running %idle transactions in primary. Suspect migration rollout (release edge-2026-03-15) applied schema change that got blocked.

Marco Ruiz: I see a migration running on writer-1: "ALTER TABLE conversation ADD COLUMN conversation_flags JSONB" — it's stuck behind an open txn. ps shows pg_locks waiting.

Priya Kapoor: that migration was part of canary batch for feature toggle enable_conversation_flags. Canary hosts started migration at 15:12.

Jon Lee: current priority: protect prod write traffic. If migration holds locks we should stop new migrations and consider kill switch for the feature flag.

Aisha Patel: immediate mitigation plan: 1) Pause rollout in deployment controller 2) Toggle feature flag off globally (kill-switch) 3) Identify and terminate blocked migration transactions if safe 4) Notify customers on incidents page. Agree? :thumbsup:

Priya Kapoor: pausing rollout now. kubectl rollout pause deploy/edge-service --namespace=prod (done)

Priya Kapoor: disabling canary flag in LaunchDarkly: off for everyone (done) — feature now rolled back logically.

Marco Ruiz: scanning DB: long-running backend 42312 is holding SHARE UPDATE EXCLUSIVE for 22m. Query:
```sql
SELECT pid, now() - pg_stat_activity.query_start AS runtime, query
FROM pg_stat_activity
WHERE state <> 'idle' AND now() - pg_stat_activity.query_start > INTERVAL '2 minutes';
```

Marco Ruiz: same session shows: BEGIN; COPY tmp_table FROM STDIN; — looks like an interrupted migration job process. We can try a graceful cancel first: SELECT pg_cancel_backend(42312);

Aisha Patel: cancel returned false — backend not responding. Marco, can you do pg_terminate_backend(42312)? Need to consider rollback cost.

Marco Ruiz: terminating now: SELECT pg_terminate_backend(42312);

incident-bot: admin action logged by Marco Ruiz at 1859004900: pg_terminate_backend(42312) executed.

Marco Ruiz: terminated. Lock cleared. Running migration step resumed but now failing fast due to partial state (duplicate column).

Jon Lee: bad. Partial DDL means clients hitting the writers may see schema mismatch errors. We should fail writes to the new code paths to avoid inconsistent states.

Priya Kapoor: rolling back application release to previous replica set (edge-2026-03-08). kubectl rollout undo deploy/edge-service --to-revision=17 (started).

Aisha Patel: starting controlled read-only mode for affected endpoints: flipping feature flags to route writes to legacy path.

Nina Chen: drafting customer notification. Status: degraded writes for some tenants between 15:12-15:45 UTC. Working on ETA.

Marco Ruiz: manual DB fix: DROP COLUMN IF EXISTS conversation_flags; (cleanup) then re-run migration from safe job on a single replica during maintenance window. Need approval to drop column in case it's partially created.

Priya Kapoor: approve cleanup, given risk of leaving partial state. Confirming with product: this flag is new and not in use for GA yet.

Aisha Patel: execute cleanup now. Marco, proceed with DROP and requeue migration as offline job.

Marco Ruiz: executing: BEGIN; ALTER TABLE conversation DROP COLUMN IF EXISTS conversation_flags; COMMIT; — success, no locks now.

incident-bot: db-backup agent: scheduled snapshot created at 1859005000 before DDL cleanup.

Aisha Patel: application rollback completed to revision 17 across all pods at 15:40 UTC. Error rate for writes falling back to baseline.

Jon Lee: reopening deploy pipeline only after we validate migrations via staging-mirror and run canary on isolated DB replica. No re-rollout to prod until confirmed.

Priya Kapoor: creating follow-up task: GH-5423 run migration-compatibility harness + add safety check to migration job (fail if locks present > 30s).

Nina Chen: customer notify sent: short message + affected window + mitigation steps + support contact.

SRE Rotation Bot: handoff reminder — Aisha, you'll hand off to next oncall in 30m. Include notes: terminated blocking txn, performed DDL cleanup, app rollback completed, follow-up GH-5423.

Aisha Patel: handing off — oncall->Marco for DB deep dive, Priya for release postmortem. If anything regresses, escalate to oncall@redwood-inference.com.

Marco Ruiz: I'll run the post-incident verification steps: extended smoke tests on write paths, re-run migration on a staging replica, add monitoring alert for long-running DDL locks.

Jon Lee: severity adjusted to Sev2 as we recovered critical write path. Will file incident report and RCA.

Nina Chen: closing loop with customers — will update tickets with postmortem link once available.

Aisha Patel: thanks everyone. Postmortem owner: Priya. Target publish: 48h. :white_check_mark:
